## Summary

- **Problem:** In the Control UI light theme (`data-theme-mode="light"`), select dropdown arrows on `.cfg-select`, `.agents-select`, and `.field select` elements are light-gray chevrons on a white background, making them nearly invisible. Additionally, `.chat-bubble:hover` highlighting is barely perceptible in light mode.
- **Solution:** Added light-mode CSS overrides supplying a dark-gray (`#444`) SVG chevron for all three select element types, with `background-repeat: no-repeat` and `background-position: right center` for `.field select` to survive the cascade from the `background` shorthand. Added an accent-colored border+glow for `.chat-bubble:hover` in light mode.
- **Files changed:**
  - `ui/src/styles/config.css` — `.cfg-select` light mode: added `background-image` with `#444` chevron
  - `ui/src/styles/components.css` — `.agents-select` light mode: added `background-image` with `#444` chevron
  - `ui/src/styles/components.css` — `.field select` light mode: added `background-image` with `#444` chevron + `background-repeat` + `background-position` (placed AFTER the `background` shorthand to avoid cascade reset)
  - `ui/src/styles/components.css` — `.chat-bubble:hover` light mode: accent border + subtle glow

## Motivation

Fixes #85713. Light-mode users couldn't see dropdown chevrons and got no hover feedback on chat bubbles.

## Screenshots (before/after pairs)

All captured headlessly on a real OpenClaw Control UI instance in light mode.

### 1. Dropdown chevrons (`.cfg-select`, `.field select`)

**Before:** No visible chevrons on the model/session/thinking selectors at top
**After:** Dark chevrons clearly visible on all three selectors

### 2. `.agents-select` chevron (tight crop)

**Before:** `#888` stroke chevron — nearly invisible on white background
**After:** `#444` stroke chevron — clearly visible

### 3. `.chat-bubble:hover` hover state

**Before:** Flat tool-output bubble, no hover distinguishability
**After:** Accent-colored border + subtle box-shadow glow on hovered bubble

## Root Cause

Select elements with custom SVG `background-image` chevrons used a light-gray stroke that works in dark mode but blends into the light-mode white background. The `.field select` rule additionally had its `background-image` silently wiped by a later `background` shorthand (CSS `background` resets all sub-properties). Chat bubble hover relied on default transitions too subtle for the light palette.

## Regression Test Plan

- Purely visual CSS fix. Visual regression testing is ideal but outside scope.
- Scenario: Light-mode Control UI shows visible dark chevrons on all select types and visible hover states on chat bubbles.

## User-visible Changes

- Light-mode select dropdown arrows now display a dark-gray `#444` chevron instead of a near-invisible light-gray one
- Light-mode chat bubbles show an accent-colored border and subtle glow on hover

## Compatibility

- Backward compatible — scoped to `:root[data-theme-mode="light"]`
- No config/env changes, no migration needed
